title: The Setup: The “Before” Scene
use_cases: Use when transforming functional dialogue into emotionally resonant scenes
Implement when surface-level conflict needs deeper character motivation
Configure when applying specific subtext techniques to existing narrative snippets
content:
The original dialogue was functional, but lifeless. Here’s a snippet:

MAYA: “We need to sell the house. The taxes are too high.”

CHLOE: “I don’t want to sell it. It’s Mom’s house.”

MAYA: “Mom’s gone, Chloe. We have to be practical.”

CHLOE: “You always just want to get rid of things.”

See? It’s all on the surface. The conflict is stated, not felt. My mission was to rewrite this scene by applying seven distinct methods of subtext, one by one, to see how they could transform the emotional core.
